newsitem.title: USA: COMEX to list additional copper options contracts.
newsitem.headline: COMEX to list additional copper options contracts.

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange said it's COMEX division received approval from Commodity Futures Trading Commission to list copper options contracts for the nearest 12 months as well as two long-dated July and December contracts, originally listed 24 months in advance.
On April 28 the exchange will list copper options for August, October and November 1997, and January, February and April 1998.

These options will expire at the close of business three business days prior to the first notice day for the underlying futures delivery month. The options will be exercised into the futures contract for the corresponding month.
